newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures mildly positive at close.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures mildly positive at close.

text.p: 1605 GMT - Italian debt markets quiet, futures ending with mild gains, cash market struggling back to just above unchanged at close. Traders say volumes thin, activity low as penultimate trading session of year draws to close. Lira steady, helped by dollar. Cabinet approves year end package of fiscal measures.
* Bonds:Jul06 +2bps at 108.75, yield 7.58 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 180.
* Futures:Mar LIF +30 bps at 128.55, sup 128.35, 128.80. * Lira:982.50/2.75 per mark vs 983 area earlier.
